name: WebMon
tagline: Interactive Web Component Picker, Visual + Code JSON/XML Mapper, Resizable Desktop & iOS Widgets, Cross-Device iCloud Sync & Local Auth Vault
short_description: Native macOS, iOS & Windows 11 interactive web browser, visual DOM component selector, and Visual + Code JSON/XML Data Mapper that pins any website element or JSON/XML API path as a resizable floating desktop widget or iOS Home/Lock Screen widget with Sign in with Apple cross-device sync, live cadence auto-refresh, custom background fills/gradients/wallpapers, pan & zoom framing, and local Keychain credential vault.
spotlight_description: WebMon v2.2 brings live web component pinning and a Visual + Code JSON & XML Structured Data Mapper across macOS, iOS (Home Screen, Lock Screen & StandBy), and Windows 11. Open any HTML webpage, JSON API endpoint (such as api.github.com/rate_limit), or XML/RSS feed in the built-in WebKit browser: tap or click to select DOM components or use the split Visual Field Tree + Code/Path Query Editor to target specific labels and values ($.a.b[0].c, /rss/channel/item[0]/title, and {{value}} / {{$.other.path}} templates). Pin them as resizable Liquid Glass desktop widgets or iOS Home & Lock Screen widgets that refresh automatically on your custom cadence (5s to 60m). Sign in with Apple to sync custom widgets, DOM & JSON/XML selectors, backgrounds, pan/zoom framing, and Lock Screen typography across Mac and iPhone via iCloud.
catalog_description: Native macOS & iOS WebKit component clipper, Visual + Code JSON & XML Structured Data Mapper, resizable floating desktop & Home/Lock Screen widget engine, live cadence refresh scheduler, Sign in with Apple cross-device iCloud sync, and local Keychain credential vault engineered in Swift 6. Features an interactive DOM element picker with scroll-anchored bounding-box overlays, automatic in-browser JSON/XML card formatting with visual tree + path query builder, multi-component widget composition, toggleable Header & Footer chrome with 100% full-card edge-to-edge bleed, custom Solid/Gradient/Wallpaper widget backgrounds, pan & zoom viewport framing, Lock Screen DOM typography widgets, and Low Effort Suite theme & icon sync.
